profile.headline: at Hewlett-Packard
profile.summary:
My objective is to becoming specialized in developing and deploying web components. Particularly interested in client/server back-end component database and architecture design, project migration as well as close interaction with clients, customers and vendors.

Languages/Technologies: ABAP, Java, C#, C++, J2EE/EJB, Hibernate, JBoss, ASP.NET, JSP, CSS, Perl
Databases: MySQL, Oracle, HP Internal Database Systems
Tools: IBM Rational ClearCase, SVN, Eclipse IDE, SAP Netweaver

positions.title: SAP Analyst/Developer
positions.description:
•	Experience in design and develop SAP logistics projects accordingly to business requirements.
•	Support unit/user acceptance testing and move to project activities.
•	Customized programs and user exits programs in ABAP using functional specifications.
•	Designed interface programs for SAP functionalities and data migration utilizing ALE/EDI technologies

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed front-end with .NET and used Java Native Interface (JNI) as communication protocol between SPJ and C++ server side components to monitor jobs and data spaces
•	Developed script to automatically install tool on-platform by generating dynamic linked library to support both Windows and *nix mode.
•	Generated and deployed stored procedure SPJ for server side and involved in defect tracking/fixing
•	Performed and validated ETL’s features and capabilities on multiple different HP Database platforms.
•	Designed and developed Java Graphical User Interface tool, which provides offline editing, input validation, ability to publish and read from remote *nix system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Master Project
•	Designed and developed three-tier application for SecureALLCorp, which describes the user organization, ownership, privileges and subtle business attributes like delegation and cross functional reporting with  technologies including Hibernate, JBoss/EJB.
•	Solely designed, and implemented the backend Oracle database structure, SQL tables, SPJ and triggers.
